items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One time, Bookie and myself did a record with Kenny Barron and John Hicks.

ctx.x: . . . on the gigs. Each one – it wasn’t a lot of money. Each guy would get a bunch of records to sell on his own. We had that kind of arrangement. So I got about two or three of those. Maybe more than that, right? So it’s a lot of trio things. One time, Bookie and myself did a record with Kenny Barron and John Hicks.
